profile_text.body:
Amazon is a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. It files with the SEC, and its EDGAR company filing page is listed as a source. The material harvested from its own website was effectively empty, so there is no description of its business in its own words to report.

The record does not list any Amazon-branded AI products. It does list five third-party MCP servers that connect to Amazon data and services: ai.agentxray/amazon-seller-mcp, which covers Amazon Seller Central and Ads in Claude or ChatGPT; ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, for querying and acting on an Amazon Ads account with guardrails over a remote MCP with OAuth; ai.trendsapi/amazon, for Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends; ai.trendsmcp/amazon, for product search demand over time with growth for any keyword; and app.apiguru/amazon-data, for live product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces. These are integrations built by outside parties, not Amazon offerings.

On the litigation side, the record notes one case, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. It also records law exposure in Washington, with a count of 114.
